review_comments: Is there a reason why this particular routine isn't being vectorized? Limited perf gains?
It can be done later if we find wins. I'd previously tried implementing https://arxiv.org/pdf/1611.07612 and found limited gains.
Do we want to specialize for the case where `T` is a reference type? (i.e. load the comparer into a local?)
It's effectively just the same as the new popcount but with an xor first on the two inputs, so if we successfully vectorize that, this should be able to follow suit.
